purpose.title: incident-triage
purpose.objective: Prioritize reversible incident actions before speculative repair.
purpose.loading_condition: Load when an Agent must choose the next incident-triage action.
purpose.highest_question: Which action reduces irreversible harm while preserving diagnosis?

judgment_role.responsibility: Order qualitative tradeoffs inside incident triage.

global_boundaries.statement: Never reveal credentials or private incident source content.

candidate.statement: Prefer reversible containment before destructive repair.
candidate.rationale: Reversible containment preserves evidence and rollback options.
does_not_apply_when: A safety emergency requires immediate irreversible action.
candidate.misuse_risk: May delay an urgent safety intervention.
contrary_evidence: An immediate safety emergency may require irreversible action.

counterexample_search.scope: Declared triage scope and urgent safety boundaries.
counterexample_search.method: Review an applicable case and a safety counterexample.
counterexample_search.uncertainty: Scenarios outside the declared triage scope were not evaluated.

confidence.reason: The decision rule and exception are explicit.

fields.one_sentence: Prefer reversible containment before destructive repair.
